figures.finding: No film may be made in Kenya without a filming licence from the Kenya Film Classification Board under the Films and Stage Plays Act (Cap 222): KES 5,000 for a documentary, advertisement, short or a TV-series episode, KES 15,000 for a feature or a series season, plus KES 1,000 a filming day; a film agent's certificate costs KES 12,000 (new or renewal).

value.law: Films and Stage Plays Act, Cap 222

sources.said: We issue filming licences to local and foreign film makers within Kenyan in line with the Films and Stage Plays Act Cap 222, Laws of Kenya. Therefore, no film shall be made in Kenya without a filming licence from us. … Both initial certificate applications and renewals cost Ksh12,000 each. … TV Series Episode, Webisode etc. 5,000.00 … Full-length feature film, TV Series Per Season and Web Series Per Season 15,000.00 … Filming fees per day 1,000.00
